methodology: Current roles are published only from the organization and Chapter's public records. A missing start date is shown as not publicly established rather than inferred from a first commit. Project-maintainer, alumni, and advisor records remain empty until the role, period, scope, and public evidence have been verified.

consentPolicy.publicEvidenceRule: Names, public GitHub profile images, public handles, and attributable public work may be summarized conservatively when the source is linked and no sensitive or non-public detail is added.
consentPolicy.explicitConsentRule: Custom biographies, non-public role details, private contact information, supplied photography, and any statement extending beyond public evidence require recorded opt-in consent before publication.
consentPolicy.removalRule: A person may request correction or removal through the published correction route; disputed optional profile material is hidden while reviewed.
consentPolicy.currentPublicationResolution: Every currently published person record uses public-evidence-only as its basis. Images are public GitHub profile images, summaries are bounded by linked public work, and no supplied photography, private contact information, non-public role date, departure explanation, testimonial, or private biography is published. Optional material remains withheld until recorded opt-in exists.

roleDefinitions.currentTeam: People with continuing organization-level responsibility recorded in Elixpo's public materials.
roleDefinitions.projectMaintainers: People accountable for the direction, review, releases, and support of a named project; this is narrower than organization membership.
roleDefinitions.researchContributors: People with attributable work in Elixpo research repositories who are not thereby presented as organization leads, employees, or formal reviewers.
roleDefinitions.majorContributors: People recognized through attributable public outcomes under the separate evidence-led contributor policy, excluding declared leads and automation.
roleDefinitions.alumni: People whose previously verified Elixpo role has ended; an alumni record never implies a reason for departure.
roleDefinitions.advisors: People with an explicitly acknowledged advisory relationship; informal help or one-time review does not create this role.
